items.title: How Trump’s Crypto Push Is Linked to Bessent’s Treasury Moves
items.summary: Treasury Secretary  Scott Bessent’s  mission to tame the bond market could get help from another Trump administration push: crypto legislation.  Last week, the U.S. Treasury announced larger buybacks of longer-term bonds.  In that context, it is notable that Bessent has in the past talked about a big potential new source of demand for Treasury bills: stablecoins.
